name: strategic-explainer
description: Turn source-grounded technical results into concise, human-readable explanations without losing meaning, uncertainty, or next actions.

interface.shortDescription: Explain technical results clearly without losing the point.
interface.longDescription: Strategic Explainer is a standalone read-only communication skill for one real user-facing comment, report, decision explanation, blocker report, final, or explicit editing request. Its router sends the publication unit to a fresh stateless subagent with exact scope and resolvable read-only sources, keeping inherited process history and caller drafts out of the explanation. The provider reconstructs the reader's core question from evidence, preserves material facts, uncertainty, impact, and the next action, and removes implementation noise, internal identifiers, mixed-language jargon, and redundant verification narration. It returns publication-ready text plus a separate source basis. It does not choose scope or status, make authority decisions, mutate systems, or bundle connectors.
defaultPrompt: Объясни этот технический результат простым языком, сохранив суть, ограничения и следующий шаг
Перепиши этот комментарий без воды, внутренних ID и двуязычной каши, не потеряв важные факты
Составь понятное объяснение блокировки: что случилось, почему это важно и что должно произойти дальше
